model.target: One enemy hero successfully hit by one supported cast.
model.damage: Raw magical damage of the explicitly identified damage instance, before target resistance.
model.coverage: Curated damage components with checked 7.42 values. Unsupported means this catalog has no eligible spell profile for the hero.
model.exclusions: Spell damage amplification, talents, upgrades, conditional stacks, variable damage, additional hits, damage over time, other targets, and actual skill distributions.
